firstRun.title: Welcome to VideoSOS 2
firstRun.what: Generate images, video, music, voices and sound effects with the best models of OpenRouter, fal and Runware, and edit them on a multitrack timeline into a finished video.
firstRun.keys: Generation runs on your own accounts: open a project, the Generate tab, and paste a provider key there or in Settings, Providers and agent. You pay the provider directly; VideoSOS shows the price before each run.
firstRun.agent: An AI agent (Claude and others) can drive VideoSOS through its MCP server; the address is in Settings.
firstRun.statisticsHint: How many generations ran and on which models, the version and the system. Never prompts, files or keys. You can change it in Settings.
